warnings.message: The delegation context carried collected_answers {confirmed: true} only, with no backlog_audit_result field, so no proposal.id-matching verdict document was available at the write site. state-write.sh's audit-evidence gate refused both writes with exit 5 until --audit-override was supplied. Both entries therefore carry an audit_override reason string rather than an audit_verdict object, unlike the immediately preceding sibling entries.
warnings.recommendation: Forward the Step 4.5 audit verdict NDJSON as backlog_audit_result in the delegation context so meta-builder-agent can pass --audit-verdict and record machine evidence on the entry.
